expectations.text: Correctly handles MLflow 3.x logged-models API (command would actually succeed)
expectations.evidence: Uses `--artifact-path model` which assumes run-level artifacts. For MLflow 3.x runs (including the target run) the model is a separate LoggedModel entity under s3://mlflow/artifacts/<exp>/models/m-<uuid>/; the run itself only has HTML plots at the root, so the CLI download would fail with 'Cannot find 'model' artifact'.
Section 1 sources mlflow_envs.sh and verifies with `env | grep`
